Hi Samir —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the project. We'd like to kick off vendor provisioning so we can route POs to GreenLeaf for the first quarter engagement. To keep momentum, can you please return the following items by end of week?

- Legal entity name and any DBA
- Registered address for tax purposes (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Federal Tax ID / VAT ID (as applicable)
- Remit-to instruction: ACH preferred (routing/account) or wire details (bank name, SWIFT, account)
- Point of contact for PO acknowledgements (name, email, phone)
- Completed W-9 (or W-8 BEN for non-US) and ACH authorization form

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and the Redwood ACH template to this email for your convenience. Once we have those, Finance will create the vendor record and confirm a vendor ID and PO routing. A few notes:

- For PO matching we usually require 'Bill To' = Redwood Inference, 'Ship/Service To' = project contact.
- If GreenLeaf wants invoices sent to a different address, include both remit and invoicing emails.

Can you confirm a date when your finance team can return the docs? If you prefer, we can run a 20-minute call to walk through the ACH fields.

Thanks —
